item.title: Rallying Cry – November 13, 2026
item.description: From Europe’s solar-battery energy breakthrough to Ghana’s heritage-celebrating cedi notes, today’s news shines with progress—plus Kansas keeps Democrats in the governor’s office and Dover’s secret WWII bunker finally opens to the public.
